Select the published nominal 1 mm two-layer build and listed ENIG option as the candidate procurement target. Native total is the exact nominal layer sum 0.010+0.043+0.900+0.043+0.010=1.006 mm, not a claim of 6 um fabrication accuracy. Finish is local to mask openings and not represented as an added full-board layer. Supplier/material/tolerance confirmation remains open.
Raspberry Pi requires separate 27 ohm resistors near the MCU. The 2 mm pad-center distance and 3 mm copper launch budget are explicit candidate layout choices, not published manufacturer maxima.

No board-mounted parallel resistor terminates the USB receptacle. RP2350 has internal USB pull resistors; the host/cable and PHY are outside the PCB-copper model. This does not authorize removing Type-C CC resistors.

Retain approximately 90 ohm differential intent. +/-9 ohm and 100 MHz are candidate engineering targets/checkpoint, not a claimed USB-IF compliance band, specified RP2350 edge frequency or measured material property. Actual mask-covered channel impedance remains unqualified.

Engineering candidate for the actual 21 x 51 mm board. All six native signal nets, 14 signal terminals and both explicit manufacturer-described protection transfers remain required. Etch length/skew measures the three PCB copper sections; package electrical delay/skew and parasitics are not assessed. Preserve 45-degree copper turns, ground/supply access and 90-ohm intent; no manufacturer, USB, ESD or physical qualification is claimed.
